comparisons.peer_summary: Data Center net revenue increased 94% to $12.6 billion in 2024 from $6.5 billion in 2023, primarily driven by higher sales of AMD Instinct GPUs and AMD EPYC CPUs. Operating income rose to $3.5 billion in 2024 from $1.3 billion in 2023, mainly due to higher revenue partially offset by increased R&D investment.
comparisons.comparison: Both QCOM and AMD report significant revenue increases in their primary high-growth segments for fiscal 2024, driven by specific product demand rather than broad macroeconomic tailwinds. QCOM attributes its $2.7 billion revenue increase in the QCT segment to higher equipment and services revenue, while AMD reports a 94% revenue increase to $12.6 billion in its Data Center segment driven by higher sales of AMD Instinct GPUs and EPYC CPUs. Both disclosures highlight these core product lines as the primary drivers of segment growth.
